locked.decision: Folio V2 is greenfield; V1 is donor material only.
Melo is mandatory presence, optional conversation, proactive 6–8 with controls.
Local encrypted vault is authoritative; cloud is optional encrypted service.
Actual transactions are truth; expectations and scenarios remain separate.
Personal and business are separated workspaces with distinct context and keys.
Plans are optional, configurable and rebased rather than failed.
AI is optional and cannot directly write records.
Core remains useful with no account, bank connection, internet or model.

agentRule: Open signoffs require seams/configuration, not silent invention.
